sentences.text: No; for cash credit/overdraft facilities, no pre-payment charges shall be applicable if the borrower intimates the UCB of its intention not to renew the facility before the period stipulated in the loan agreement, provided the facility gets closed on the due date.

The current UCB pre-payment-charge directions also say that, in cases other than the specific exceptions for paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, are otherwise governed by the UCB’s approved policy.
